reference_implementation_a.sql: WITH per_customer AS (SELECT c.region, c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS completed_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.region, c.customer_id) SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(completed_orders)::numeric, 2) AS avg_completed_orders FROM per_customer GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

reference_implementation_b.sql: SELECT c.region, ROUND(AVG((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed'))::numeric, 2) AS avg_completed_orders FROM customers c GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region
